checks: Failed or instrument-invalid stage does not open saved model response.
Missing stage review is not accepted.
Completed malformed/structure-failed output remains raw text with null numeric diagnostics.
Source-free stage keeps source fidelity not applicable; no invented rating.
Frozen response hash mismatch is refused.
F0 preserves exact own D0 text and raw deltas; another run prior response is refused.
Visible source packet must match frozen compact packet.
Citation membership does not become semantic support.
Duplicate keys, nonfinite constants and boolean weights are not silently accepted.
Negative raw values remain diagnostics rather than being normalized/clipped.
Decimal sums preserve digits beyond default Decimal context.

errors.reason: Targeted boundary fixtures exercised failure, malformed output, wrong hash/source/prior-run and precise numeric cases without actual inference.

consistency.reason: Helper writes only a new audit bundle; bound source/prepared inputs and raw output remain unchanged. All semantic categories remain pending until actual reading.

paper_topic.reason: The bundle exposes source meaning, stated reasons, actual raw weights, shared context and own-stage changes. Structural string/ID matches are explicitly not a source-use success score.

limitations: Fifteen synthetic tests are software checks, not evidence that any pending continuation output is correct.
No actual running stage was opened or graded in these tests.
Bound actual complete response integration remains to be used only once durable stage receipts exist.
